engine: studio-video-engine worker dispatch (codex exec subagents), pytest runs, .agents skill edits
environment: Windows 11, codex exec workspace-write sandbox (Gemini/DeepSeek/GPT routes), 2026-10-28 wave
symptom: Codex workers failed in the sandbox: .agents was read-only; a nested codex exec returned EPERM; pytest's default temp dir raised PermissionError; M9b-1 and CR-M4f1c could not run their exact command and judged by reading only.
root_cause: Measured in the worker logs: the sandbox restricts writes outside the workspace (including the .agents tree and the default %TEMP%), forbids child-process creation for nested codex, and blocks pytest's default basetemp. This is sandbox policy, not a broken install. Same family as codex-sandbox-blocks-chromium-remotion-render (create-video-jenniejoykids/error-db). Plan evidence: M9b-1 (gpt-6-astra, 131,650 tokens; exact command failed only on temp-dir permission), CR-M4f1c (7,549,772 tokens in under 15 minutes, PermissionError, judged by reading only).
root_cause_status: measured (worker output and PermissionError lines; root re-ran outside the sandbox: M9b-1 94 passed, M4-f1c 64 passed)
fix_or_workaround: Claude native workers own every .agents edit and every live UAT (root runs the live ComfyUI/Docker/Remotion steps unsandboxed). Codex/Gemini/DeepSeek critics run read-only with --basetemp inside the workspace and at most 5 files per capsule. Root re-runs the test command outside the sandbox before accepting any worker's pass.
verification: Root re-run outside the sandbox: M9b-1 94 passed, M9b-2 160 passed, M4-f1c 64 passed (plan section 5). The rule that a worker's own pass is not accepted until root re-runs it is in plan section 4.
prevention: Rule to keep: a sandboxed worker never owns .agents edits, live UAT, nested codex, or a pytest run with the default temp dir. Give it config or code work and state 'root runs the test'. Critic capsules: --basetemp inside the workspace, <=5 files, <=20 tool calls. Never accept a worker's self-reported pass; re-run it outside the sandbox.
status: workaround (routing rule) — the sandbox policy itself is unchanged
